name: Scarborough Camping and Caravanning Club Site
accommodation: Grass and hardstanding pitches, with or without electric hook-up, plus jumbo pitches
dogs: Pets welcome; dog walk and exercise field
beachAccess: Short cliff-top walk; guests describe a short walk to North Bay
confirmedFeatures: Showers, accessible facilities, laundry, shop, Wi-Fi, play area, motorhome service point, backpacker facilities
overview: A Camping and Caravanning Club site at Field Lane, off Burniston Road, on the northern edge of Scarborough. It offers grass, hardstanding and large pitches, with a shop, laundry and play areas, and sits a short cliff-top walk from the town and North Bay. Open late March to late October.
surfTripFit: A practical van or tent base on the North Bay side of town, with a dog-friendly set-up and easy access to the cliff-top path.
